formulaBlock.normalization: Packet canonicalInci used as normalized list (ID-2); positions are one-based on that list.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C6: no strong anionic; earliest prominent surfactant is a mild anionic taurate (2) with prominent glucoside (3, 9) and amphoteric (4) co-surfactants -> low.

conditioningLevel.rationale: W-RICH rich architecture: prominent payload lipids (Argan Oil 7, Hydrogenated Castor Oil 12) converge with an amino-silicone (10) and cationic guar (11), plus keratin (6) and a pearlizer (15) -> high anchor. C2 itself is not met: no closed-list humectant (Hexylene Glycol does not count, R11).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Missing C2 humectant element; argan and amodimethicone amounts unknown.

weightPotential.rationale: W-RICH with limited reset: prominent argan oil and waxy hydrogenated castor oil converge with amodimethicone, guar, keratin and a film-type starch, under a mild C6 chassis (resetCapacity weak) -> high.
weightPotential.counterSignal: Rinse-off context and unknown concentrations; amodimethicone deposits selectively.

depositionLoad.rationale: Five deposition families: payload lipids 7/12, amino-silicone 10, cationic guar 11, keratin 6, possible film starch 8.

persistence.rationale: Amodimethicone and hydrogenated castor oil are substantive; argan oil liquid.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Rich architecture (W-RICH) plus limited reset; multiple converging systems.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: W-RICH holds (prominent argan oil and waxy castor oil with silicone and cationic) and reset is weak, so the high anchor's rich route is satisfied and reset does not offset it.
weightPotential.limitingFactor: Concentrations of argan oil/amodimethicone in a rinse-off; potato-starch role.
